blurb: Wasaga 500 features a 2 km high banked Lemans style go-kart track with 50 karts, batting cages with 9 true pitch baseball and softball cages, and two Harris mini golf courses. Children under 4 play mini-golf free, and children 9 and under ride free on two-seater karts with a paying adult. The facility is family owned and operated and includes a snack bar.
extraNote: 12 laps for $100 is cash only to save processing fees · Group pricing available for groups of 6+
